Observed 2026-10-19 on Darwin, patch 2.0-12u11-Apple.
Command: /usr/bin/patch -f -p0 < input.patch
The fixture contains one old-to-new line replacement.

absolute: exit=0 target=new
patching file '<fixture>/capture/target/x'
dotdot: exit=0 target=new
patching file '../target/x'

Both forms modified the named target outside the working directory.
Keep the protected-header rule.
